palette.affects: Coordinated page, surface, foreground, border, link and primary colours. Light/dark follows data-theme. Success, warning and error colours stay semantic.

usage.targets: Page and supported component backgrounds, text, borders, links and primary colours.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local palette redeclares palette colour tokens, including primary; a local accent on the same element overrides its primary colours. A local tone on the same element overrides surface colours.
usage.dependencies: Core tokens and styles; theme selects the light/dark values.
usage.limitations: Does not recolour semantic success/warning/danger roles or load a custom palette. Custom palette names need application CSS.

theme.affects: Page and component colour scheme: auto follows the visitor's preference.

usage.targets: Page and supported component colour schemes and browser controls using color-scheme.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Use light, dark or auto locally; auto follows the system preference rather than the parent explicit mode.
usage.dependencies: Core adaptive colours; native control rendering remains browser-owned.
usage.limitations: Does not select a palette, load a material or persist a visitor preference.

accent.affects: Primary actions, badges, alerts, native accent controls and checked switches. Links retain their theme colour. Explicit accents reset their foreground; omitted accents follow data-palette.

usage.targets: Primary actions, badges, alerts, native accent controls, checked switches and other consumers of primary tokens.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A nearer accent replaces primary start/end and foreground. There is no palette or default accent literal; remove the override to inherit, accounting for nearer palette declarations.
usage.dependencies: Core primary tokens; semantic variants can select their own colours.
usage.limitations: Does not recolour ordinary links or replace semantic danger/warning/success colours.

shape.affects: Styled controls, surfaces, navigation, media, code, choice labels, avatars and placeholders. Custom uses --re-custom-surface-radius, --re-custom-field-radius and --re-custom-action-radius (nonnegative lengths; .75rem defaults). Local presets reset all three groups.

usage.targets: Styled controls, surfaces, navigation, media, code, choice labels, avatars and placeholders.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local preset resets surface, field and action radius groups. Custom reads --re-custom-surface-radius, --re-custom-field-radius and --re-custom-action-radius with .75rem fallbacks.
usage.dependencies: Core styles; custom radiuses need valid nonnegative CSS lengths.
usage.limitations: Does not make every element pill-shaped; individual component geometry can cap a radius. Custom properties do not select custom mode by themselves.

fill.affects: Button, badge and alert gradients; optional glass sheen. Does not change material.

usage.targets: Gradient treatment on supported actions, badges and alerts, plus sheen in extensions that consume the fill token.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Use solid locally to remove the supported gradient contribution; gradient restores it without changing other settings.
usage.dependencies: Core styles; optional materials provide their own supported sheen treatment.
usage.limitations: Does not select an opaque surface or reset Glass. Outline/ghost actions can have no filled gradient to change.

density.affects: Control and surface padding, list and description spacing, card sections and layout spacing. Custom separates surface padding (--re-custom-surface-padding, 1rem), control padding multiplier (--re-custom-control-density, 1), and content spacing (--re-custom-content-space, 1rem). Minimum control heights are preserved; local presets reset all groups.

usage.targets: Control/surface padding, list/description spacing, card sections and layout spacing.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local built-in preset resets all density groups. Custom separates surface padding, control multiplier and content spacing through the documented --re-custom-* density tokens.
usage.dependencies: Core styles; data-gap independently multiplies supported layout gaps.
usage.limitations: Does not remove minimum control heights or resize page typography. Custom spacing tokens need custom mode and valid values.

depth.affects: Action and surface shadows. Text-control inset shadows are configured with data-controls.

usage.targets: Supported action and surface shadows, including extension-specific Soft UI depth.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Flat, subtle or pronounced locally replaces the supported shadow/depth tokens.
usage.dependencies: Core shadows; Soft UI-specific shadows require its surface or independent action material extension.
usage.limitations: Does not control text-field inset shadows. Outline/ghost, pressed states, navbar finish and accessibility preferences can suppress shadows.

motion.affects: Action transitions, accordion expansion and chevron rotation (expressive adds a fade), press movement, decorative edges, custom spinners, switch transitions and skeleton shimmer. Reduced motion wins; native progress is browser-owned.

usage.targets: Supported transitions, presses, disclosure motion, decorative edges, custom spinners, switches and skeletons.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Use none locally to stop supported framework motion, or a documented preset to restore it subject to user preferences.
usage.dependencies: Complete core includes disclosure motion; optional reva.motion.css adds native overlay motion. Use scoped equivalents with scoped core.
usage.limitations: Does not animate arbitrary markup or control browser-owned progress animation. Reduced motion wins; no setting supplies application state changes.

usage.targets: Page/subtree typography and descendants that inherit relative font sizes.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local compact, standard or large establishes that subtree font size using the corresponding typography token.
usage.dependencies: Core text styles; component font rules still apply.
usage.limitations: Does not replace data-size or scale every rem-based dimension; it is not proof of browser zoom or text adaptability.

border.affects: Styled control and surface borders, table rules and navigation boundaries. Invalid-state and forced-colour boundaries take priority.

usage.targets: Supported control/surface borders, table rules and navigation boundaries.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local preset changes shared border thickness without resetting shape, material or semantic state.
usage.dependencies: Core styles; table grid visibility also follows data-table.
usage.limitations: None does not remove focus outlines or required invalid/forced-colour boundaries. Decorative edge paint is configured separately.

contrast.affects: Foreground and boundary contrast; optional glass becomes opaque. System preferences retain their component-specific priority.

usage.targets: Supported foreground/boundary contrast and extension-specific opaque or simplified material treatment.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: More strengthens relevant tokens. Auto restores only explicitly implemented local resets, such as edge visibility and extension finish tokens; it does not redeclare every foreground/border token inherited from more.
usage.dependencies: Complete core preference utilities and any loaded material extensions.
usage.limitations: Auto is not a universal inverse of more and cannot defeat system preferences. This setting does not certify contrast on arbitrary custom backgrounds.

tone.affects: Override page and surface temperature without resetting the palette accent, links or foregrounds.

usage.targets: Page/surface background temperature tokens.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local neutral, cool or warm redeclares surface colours; neutral selects the framework neutral surfaces. Omission inherits the existing surfaces, which may come from a parent tone or palette.
usage.dependencies: Core surface tokens; theme selects light/dark values.
usage.limitations: Does not change accent, links or foregrounds. Palette surfaces is an omitted-default description, not a supported attribute value or a neutral alias.

controls.affects: Text input, select and textarea backing and inset shadow.

usage.targets: Styled text inputs, selects and textareas with backing/inset treatment.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Minimal removes supported backing/inset treatment; styled restores its tokens locally. Soft UI also observes a minimal scope for its field shadow.
usage.dependencies: Core form styling; optional Soft UI supplies its own field treatment.
usage.limitations: Does not restyle actions, checkboxes, radios or every native picker. Minimal does not remove labels, focus or validation boundaries.

width.affects: Page-container width. Narrow, Standard and Wide cap .container at 48rem, 75rem and 90rem. Full fills the parent with 1rem side padding. Custom uses --re-custom-max-width (75rem) and --re-custom-side-padding (1rem); max width includes padding, which is reduced in narrow containers. Local presets reset width/padding. Navbar width is configured separately.

usage.targets: .container width and consumers of the shared container-width token.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local preset resets width/padding; full fills the parent with side padding. Custom uses --re-custom-max-width and --re-custom-side-padding with documented defaults.
usage.dependencies: Core container styling and an actual .container for page-container layout.
usage.limitations: Does not set arbitrary element widths, escape a constrained parent or configure navbar surface width; use data-navbar-width for that choice.

table.affects: Table stripes and grid lines; rule thickness follows data-border.

usage.targets: Native table stripes and cell grid lines.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Plain removes optional stripes/grid lines; striped and bordered select their documented treatment locally.
usage.dependencies: Core table styles; rule thickness follows data-border.
usage.limitations: Bordered with data-border=none has zero-width shared rules. Does not add sorting, pagination, responsive wrapping or header associations.

table-sticky.scope: Local; non-table scroll wrapper with a direct table child. Not inherited.
table-sticky.affects: Creates a native scroll container and optionally pins its direct table header group, first column or both. No wrapper class is required.

usage.targets: A non-table wrapper containing a direct native table child. Keep caption, thead/tbody/tfoot and th scopes in native markup.
usage.inheritance: Local only. This setting is not inherited and does not configure nested tables. Attributes on html or the table itself do not activate it.
usage.localOverride: Use none for ordinary scrolling without pinning; header, column or both enable their named behaviour on that wrapper. Omission preserves existing layout; .table-scroll remains supported.
usage.dependencies: Complete global/scoped build, or tokens + base + components. Set an application max-block-size or block-size for internal vertical scrolling; no height is forced.
usage.limitations: Column pinning is disabled for tables with direct cells spanning multiple rows/columns; both retains header pinning. Header groups may have multiple rows. Pinned backgrounds are opaque using theme tokens to prevent text bleed. Print removes pinning and wrapper height limits. No sorting, filtering, hover mode or JavaScript is added. Browser acceptance is deferred.

size.affects: Controls, menu actions, badges, alerts, accordion summaries, breadcrumbs, pagination, form labels, choice labels, spinners and avatars.

usage.targets: Controls, menu actions, badges, alerts, summaries, breadcrumbs, pagination, form/choice labels, spinners and avatars.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local small, medium or large replaces the inherited component scale.
usage.dependencies: Core and relevant component styles.
usage.limitations: Does not set general page text size, card width or arbitrary element dimensions. Minimum target sizes and component-specific geometry still apply.

ratio.affects: Image and video aspect ratio; auto retains natural proportions.

usage.targets: Image and video aspect ratio.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A nearer ratio selects a supported aspect ratio; auto restores natural proportions.
usage.dependencies: Core media styling; fitting cropped/letterboxed content also uses data-fit.
usage.limitations: Does not constrain arbitrary cards or SVG charts. Auto does not impose a fixed media box.

fit.affects: Image, video and avatar content within constrained dimensions.

usage.targets: Image/video content and supported avatar media within their boxes.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Cover fills the constrained media box; contain keeps the content within it.
usage.dependencies: Core/media component styles; a constrained box or aspect ratio is needed for a visible fitting difference.
usage.limitations: May have no visible effect when natural proportions already match the box. Does not style CSS background images or set a width/height itself.

gap.affects: Spacing in .grid, .row, .stack, .accordion, .pagination, .tabs and .toolbar; combines with density.

usage.targets: .grid, .row, .stack, .accordion, .pagination, .tabs and .toolbar gaps.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local preset replaces the gap multiplier; medium restores multiplier 1 while retaining the current density spacing.
usage.dependencies: Relevant core layout/component styling; combines with density content spacing.
usage.limitations: Does not create a grid/flex layout, add gaps to an ordinary div or replace padding/margins.

material.affects: Solid surfaces by default; optional Glass or Soft UI surfaces and actions use their matching extension. Veil is deprecated and retained for existing sites. Explicit material boundaries stop another inherited material.

deprecatedValues.veil: Deprecated; retained for existing sites. Use solid, glass or soft for new interfaces.

usage.targets: Documented surfaces and actions; Soft UI also has documented text-field styling. Exact targets depend on the selected extension.
usage.inheritance: Configure a material scope on a parent or supported target. Scoped selectors stop at explicit nested material boundaries as described in localOverride; this is not plain attribute inheritance. Keep content inside its .reva boundary with the scoped build.
usage.localOverride: An explicit material boundary stops a different parent material scope; solid supplies the documented local reset. A nested supported material can re-enter its own scope.
usage.dependencies: Core for solid; matching Glass, Soft UI or deprecated Veil extension for those finishes, loaded after the core. Use scoped counterparts when scoped.
usage.limitations: An arbitrary element does not become a surface. Independent button material can override action paint. Unsupported material values can stop a parent scope without activating a replacement; never use them as resets.

edge.affects: Decorative borders on buttons, .button links and cards. Shine sweeps on interaction; animated turns continuously. Native action inputs keep regular borders.

usage.targets: Decorative borders on buttons, .button links and cards.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Plain removes edge decoration; gradient, shine or animated selects the documented edge treatment locally.
usage.dependencies: Complete core edge styling; motion, contrast and system preferences control animation/visibility.
usage.limitations: Native action inputs keep regular borders. Shine is interaction-driven; animated is continuous only when preferences and motion allow it. Does not decorate every surface.

variant.affects: Button, action-input, .button link, badge and alert semantic colour. Primary uses the inherited accent; local legacy button classes override inherited variants, while a valid action-level attribute takes precedence.

usage.targets: Supported actions, badges and alerts; navigation toggles retain their documented treatment.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A nearer valid variant selects semantic colours. Legacy danger/warning/secondary action classes override an inherited variant; a valid attribute on that action takes precedence over those classes.
usage.dependencies: Core actions and relevant badge/alert styling; primary uses local primary/accent tokens.
usage.limitations: Does not create validation messages or application error state. Secondary is an action class, not a supported data-variant value.

appearance.affects: Badge and alert backing and border treatment. Does not configure buttons.

usage.targets: Badge and alert backing/border treatment.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Tinted, solid or outline locally replaces the inherited badge/alert appearance.
usage.dependencies: Badge/alert styles included in the complete core.
usage.limitations: Does not configure buttons or select a surface material. Use documented outline/ghost action classes for action appearance.

navbar.affects: Top navigation layout: standard brand and links, centered links, inset floating surface, or central brand with links on either side. Mobile retains the shared Menu button and popovers. Does not change sidebars.

usage.targets: .top-menu layout.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: A local layout preset resets the navbar layout variables, preserving separate position/spacing/width settings.
usage.dependencies: Complete core navigation styling and the full documented top-menu structure.
usage.limitations: Does not change sidebars or implement mobile behaviour without the documented native controls and panels.

navbar-position.scope: Inherited; applies to .navbar-header, standalone .top-menu and .app-shell > header
navbar-position.affects: Static follows normal document flow. Sticky keeps the outer header at block-start of its scroll container; layout, palette and material remain independent. Put the wrapper in the scrolling page, outside short sections.

usage.targets: .navbar-header, standalone .top-menu and .app-shell > header positioning.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Static restores normal flow; sticky selects supported sticky positioning within the current scroll container.
usage.dependencies: Navigation/app-shell styles; the wrapper must have useful scrolling space within its containing block.
usage.limitations: Does not create fixed positioning or escape a short/clipping parent. Does not change navbar layout, palette or material.

navbar-spacing.affects: Flush removes the wrapper gap and Floating margins so a sticky bar meets the safe top edge. Spaced adds wrapper breathing room, reduced on small screens, and retains Floating margins.

usage.targets: .navbar-header and standalone .top-menu wrapper spacing/finish.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Flush removes wrapper breathing room/Floating margins; spaced restores documented responsive spacing.
usage.dependencies: Documented navigation wrapper and styles; safe-area rules still apply.
usage.limitations: Does not reset general page density or all gaps inside menu panels.

navbar-width.affects: Contained follows the shared page width and navbar layout. Full fills its parent with a navbar surface while aligning its contents to the shared page width. Use a page-wide wrapper to reach both screen edges; app-shell toolbars retain their grid column.

usage.targets: .navbar-header and .top-menu surface/content width rules.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: Contained follows shared page width/layout; full fills the parent surface while aligning contents to page width.
usage.dependencies: Navigation styling and an appropriately wide parent wrapper.
usage.limitations: Full does not escape a constrained parent; app-shell headers retain their grid column. Does not change every page .container.

button-material.scope: Inherited; native button/submit/reset actions and .button/.scroll-top links, excluding navigation toggles and dropdown controls
button-material.affects: Optional button material extension. Default follows data-material at the action; explicit choices override general material for actions only. Liquid is transparent neutral glass without accent tint; movement follows data-motion. Veil is deprecated and retained for existing sites.

deprecatedValues.veil: Deprecated; retained for existing sites. Use solid, glass or soft for new interfaces.

usage.targets: Native button/submit/reset actions and .button/.scroll-top links, excluding menu toggles and dropdown controls.
usage.inheritance: Configure a material scope on a parent or supported target. Scoped selectors stop at explicit nested material boundaries as described in localOverride; this is not plain attribute inheritance. Keep content inside its .reva boundary with the scoped build.
usage.localOverride: An explicit action-material boundary stops the parent action-material scope. Default installs no independent finish, allowing general data-material treatment; it is not an alias for solid.
usage.dependencies: reva.button-materials.css or its scoped counterpart for independent finishes. A different material on surrounding surfaces needs its own extension.
usage.limitations: Does not style cards or navigation toggles. Unsupported values can stop a parent action-material scope without installing another finish. Veil is deprecated; system preferences can replace decorative paint.

font.scope: Inherited; page, section or individual text/control
font.affects: Body text, headings and native controls. Manrope is the framework default with system-ui/sans-serif fallback; its font stylesheet is optional. System uses system-ui/sans-serif even when Manrope is loaded. A local preset resets this choice; code remains monospace and --re-font-heading remains an optional heading override.

usage.targets: Body/subtree text, headings and native controls; code retains the monospace contract.
usage.inheritance: Configure on html for global defaults, or on a local parent/target. CSS tokens and scoped selectors apply the setting to supported descendants; the HTML attribute itself does not inherit. Omission keeps the inherited setting within the current boundary; each scoped .reva boundary initializes its own defaults. Read localOverride for setting-specific exceptions.
usage.localOverride: System selects device UI fonts even when Manrope is loaded; manrope restores the default family stack locally. An explicit --re-font-heading remains an independent heading override.
usage.dependencies: Core font rules. Optional reva-fonts.css and adjacent fonts/ files provide Manrope; the default stack remains usable without them.
usage.limitations: Selecting manrope does not download a font or require Google Fonts. Does not change code to proportional text or remove an application heading-font override.
